subject: Re: Kickoff: logit adjustment for long-tail classifiers
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing through the window:

- Carmen Reyes 40% on the reproduction and the eval methodology (per-class accuracy breakdowns, not just top-1).
- Linnea Yamada 20% supporting Evalline integration of the long-tail metrics.
- Farah Haddad 30% in March-April on the trainer flag, then Farah Haddad is committed at 60% to this project for May 2026 to drive the trainer integration and the partner-team pilot — I've locked that with her directly. The pilot month is where integration bugs surface, so I want her depth there.

Compute: tiny. The CIFAR runs are single-GPU; the pilot uses the partner's existing quota. 4 A100s on titan-a100 covers everything on our side.

Only dependency: the partner team confirms their May pilot dataset by Apr 17.

Jelena
